SELECT count(t.id) AS called
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring}) 
      OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
  )

LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.completion_reason = 'completed'

WITH base_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
        COUNT(t.id) AS served_count,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS avg_wait,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60) AS avg_service,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS avg_total,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS percentile_wait,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60) AS percentile_service,
        percentile_cont((${percentile:raw}::numeric / 100.0)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS percentile_total
    FROM tickets t
    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
      AND t.finished_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно')
)
SELECT
    operator_name AS "Сотрудник",
    served_count AS "Этапов закрыто",
    ROUND(avg_wait::numeric, 2) AS "Ср. ожид. (мин)",
    ROUND(avg_service::numeric, 2) AS "Ср. обслуж. (мин)",
    ROUND(avg_total::numeric, 2) AS "Ср. общее (мин)",
    ROUND(percentile_wait::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} ожид. (мин)",
    ROUND(percentile_service::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} обслуж. (мин)",
    ROUND(percentile_total::numeric, 2) AS "P${percentile:raw} общее (мин)"
FROM base_stats
ORDER BY "Этапов закрыто" DESC;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time_from,
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time_to
), workdays AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST((day::date + time '08:00') AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), bounds.time_from) AS day_start,
        LEAST((day::date + time '17:00') AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), bounds.time_to) AS day_end
    FROM bounds
    CROSS JOIN generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', bounds.time_from AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1)),
        date_trunc('day', bounds.time_to AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1)),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
), clipped_periods AS (
    SELECT
        osp.operator_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
        osp.status,
        GREATEST(osp.started_at, workdays.day_start) AS period_start,
        LEAST(COALESCE(osp.ended_at, workdays.day_end), workdays.day_end) AS period_end
    FROM operator_status_periods osp
    JOIN workdays
      ON workdays.day_start < workdays.day_end
     AND osp.started_at < workdays.day_end
     AND COALESCE(osp.ended_at, workdays.day_end) > workdays.day_start
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = osp.operator_id
    WHERE (
        'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
        OR osp.operator_id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
    )
), totals AS (
    SELECT
        operator_id,
        operator_name,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (period_end - period_start)))
            FILTER (WHERE status = 'online' AND period_start < period_end) AS online_seconds,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (period_end - period_start)))
            FILTER (WHERE status = 'break' AND period_start < period_end) AS break_seconds,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (period_end - period_start)))
            FILTER (WHERE status = 'offline' AND period_start < period_end) AS offline_seconds
    FROM clipped_periods
    GROUP BY operator_id, operator_name
)
SELECT
    operator_name AS "Сотрудник",
    ROUND(COALESCE(online_seconds, 0)::numeric / 3600, 2) AS "Онлайн, ч",
    ROUND(COALESCE(break_seconds, 0)::numeric / 3600, 2) AS "Перерыв, ч",
    ROUND(COALESCE(offline_seconds, 0)::numeric / 3600, 2) AS "Офлайн, ч"
FROM totals
ORDER BY operator_name;

where status = 'waiting'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'online'

SELECT 
    t.number AS "Номер",
    s.name AS "Услуга",
    to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Время создания",
    CASE 
        WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN 
            ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - t.called_at))/60, 2)
        ELSE 
            ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - t.created_at))/60, 2)
    END AS "Время ожидания (мин)",
    CASE 
        WHEN t.status = 'waiting' THEN 'Ожидает'
        WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN 'Обслуживается'
        WHEN t.status = 'deferred' THEN 'Отложен'
        ELSE t.status
    END AS "Статус",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Не назначен') AS "Оператор",
    COALESCE(t.defer_reason, 'Нет причины') AS "Причина отложения",
    CASE 
        WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN to_char(t.called_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), 'HH24:MI:SS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "Время начала обслуживания"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.status in ('waiting', 'called', 'deferred')
ORDER BY 
    CASE t.status
        WHEN 'called' THEN 1
        WHEN 'waiting' THEN 2
        WHEN 'deferred' THEN 3
    END,
    t.created_at ASC;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    s.name AS "Услуга",
    CASE 
        WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN 'Предоставляется'
        WHEN s.status = 'inactive' THEN 'Не предоставляется'
        ELSE 'Неизвестно'
    END AS "Статус"
FROM services s;

SELECT 
    s.name AS "Сервис",
    COUNT(t.id) AS "Билетов в ожидании"
FROM tickets t
JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
WHERE t.status = 'waiting'
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY "Билетов в ожидании" DESC;

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time_from,
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time_to
), workdays AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST((day::date + time '08:00') AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), bounds.time_from) AS day_start,
        LEAST((day::date + time '17:00') AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1), bounds.time_to) AS day_end
    FROM bounds
    CROSS JOIN generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', bounds.time_from AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1)),
        date_trunc('day', bounds.time_to AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM ticket_counter_state WHERE id = 1)),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
), clipped_periods AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
        GREATEST(osp.started_at, workdays.day_start) AS period_start,
        LEAST(COALESCE(osp.ended_at, workdays.day_end), workdays.day_end) AS period_end,
        CASE osp.status
            WHEN 'offline' THEN 0
            WHEN 'online' THEN 1
            WHEN 'break' THEN 2
        END AS status_code
    FROM operator_status_periods osp
    JOIN workdays
      ON workdays.day_start < workdays.day_end
     AND osp.started_at < workdays.day_end
     AND COALESCE(osp.ended_at, workdays.day_end) > workdays.day_start
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = osp.operator_id
    WHERE (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR osp.operator_id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
)
SELECT
    period_start AS "time",
    period_end AS "timeEnd",
    operator_name AS metric,
    status_code AS value
FROM clipped_periods
WHERE period_start < period_end
ORDER BY metric, "time";

SELECT
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS "Время ожидания, мин",
    COUNT(*) AS "Количество человек"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
                      AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH called_tickets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'completed' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап завершен успешно'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'redirected' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап перенаправлен'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'cancelled' THEN 'Отменено'
            WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN 'В обслуживании сейчас'
            ELSE 'Не завершено / прочее'
        END AS outcome
    FROM tickets t
    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.called_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
          OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      )
)
SELECT
    outcome AS "Исход",
    count(*) AS "Этапов",
    ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "Доля, %"
FROM called_tickets
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY "Этапов" DESC;

SELECT
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60) AS "Время обслуживания, мин",
    COUNT(*) AS "Количество человек"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
                        AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
    t.window_id AS window_id,
    COALESCE(w.name, 'Неизвестно') AS window_name,
    COUNT(*) AS suspicious_count,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_duration_seconds,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS min_duration_seconds,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS max_duration_seconds
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON w.id = t.window_id
WHERE t.status = 'finished'
  AND t.completion_reason = 'completed'
  AND t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (t.finished_at - t.called_at) < INTERVAL '1.5 minutes'
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.name), ''), 'Неизвестно'), t.window_id, w.name
ORDER BY suspicious_count DESC, avg_duration_seconds ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS "Общее время, мин",
    COUNT(*) AS "Количество человек"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
                        AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
      OR o.id::text IN (${operator_id:sqlstring})
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
